text: Program Description This program aimed to train students to master knowledge of software engineering andthe development of advanced technology. All courses taught in English, without chinese language proficiency requirment. The college is equipped a provinvial key labs in Liaoning Province, computer network intelligent expermental center. Teaching Objective The major is aimed to train students to master thebasic theoretical knowledge of software engineering andthe development of advanced technology,with software developmentand management ability, who can be engaged in thesoftware system analysis,design, development and project management. Future Career Graduates can be software engineers to engage in thesoftware system analysis,design, development and project management. Diploma and Awarded Bachelor of Engineering degree
